name: list_books
title: List books
description: Lists the books in the writer's Inkling library, newest first, with each one's id, title, author, format, number of chapters and where the writer is in it.

name: read_book
title: Read a book
description: Without a chapter, gives a book's contents: its chapters, numbered from 0. With a chapter, gives that chapter's text as Markdown.

name: search_library
title: Search the library
description: Finds text in the library's books, ignoring case. Each hit gives the book, the chapter and the passage around it.

name: read_draft
title: Read the draft
description: Gives the writer's current draft, as the Markdown they are writing.
